Class ValueSelection

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.ValueSelection
public final class ValueSelection extends Object
The values of a stack which are displayed as a volume or an iso surface: all values (the default), a range of values (e.g., the threshold of the image in ImageJ: only the particles) or a list of values (the labels of a segmentation).

The iso surface of a range is the surface of the values at both limits (interpolated like the iso surface of a value), the iso surface of a list of labels is the surface of the voxels with one of the labels (the border between a selected and another voxel, half way between the centers of the voxels).
